title: Spacebook.List
$comment: The whole Spacebook, sent on login, on Core.Supports, every 30 s when changed, after every mutation, and in answer to Spacebook.Get. With `error` there is no live book (self is a placeholder, both lists empty); with `cached` the list is the pad's last sync.

error.$comment: Why there is no live book, e.g. "Your wristpad has no signal here. PDAs only work in character."

cached.$comment: Unix seconds of the pad's last sync, when the list is shown off-net.

share_friends.$comment: Whether your buddies can see your friends.

role.$comment: Line of work; '' for most players.
